name: STIckER (STI Check in the Emergency Room)
summary: A digital patient decision aid designed to increase sexually transmitted infection testing in the emergency department. Evaluated in a pilot randomized controlled trial and now in a multisite cluster randomized stepped-wedge implementation-effectiveness trial (NIAID R01AI196113).

name: Enhanced STI and Mpox Surveillance via Health Information Exchange
summary: Use of health information exchange and triple-site testing data to characterize STI trends, HIV viral load suppression, and to build machine learning-based mpox surveillance models within a learning health system.

name: Doxy-PEP Patient Decision Aid (Is Doxy-PEP Right for Me?)
summary: A novel patient decision aid piloted in an urban ambulatory clinic to support shared decision-making around doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis for STI prevention.

name: Mpox Severity Scoring System
summary: Developed and piloted a clinical severity scoring system for mpox to standardize assessment of disease severity.

name: HIV Antiretroviral Stewardship and Long-Acting Injectable Implementation (ALAI UP)
summary: Work supporting increased uptake of long-acting injectable antiretrovirals among people with HIV, including clinic-level implementation analysis and the PrEP-SIC roadmap.

name: VP&S AI Research and Informatics Workgroups
summary: Institutional roles evaluating and guiding AI and emerging technology adoption at Columbia, including the Emerging Technology and Informatics Subcommittee and the VP&S AI Research and AI Training and Education Workgroups.
